item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Camo Shopping Bag is the perfect solution for merchants seeking stylish and durable bags for promotional events or everyday use. Made from heavy-duty materials, this reusable bag features a striking camouflage design that sets it apart from standard bags, making it an excellent choic for retail stores, trade shows, or giveaways. Measuring 18 inch x 24 inch, the spacious bag provides ample room for carrying large items, groceries, or merchandise, while its strong handles ensure durability and comfort during use.
